messages.text:
Hello BrightHome Customer Service,

I am writing regarding my order for 1 x LED desk lamp with dimmer ($30.00 total), paid via PayPal on Nov 5 and shipped via USPS. The lamp arrived damaged: the base is cracked. Because the item arrived damaged, I would like a full refund of $30.00. Please let me know how to proceed with the return or any documentation you need.

Thank you,
A shopper
Sorry it arrived damaged. We can refund 50% ($15.00) and you keep the item. A full refund needs the item shipped back at your own cost.

recommendation.reasoning: You should accept the $15 partial refund because a cracked base on a $30 lamp is likely cosmetic if it still works, and returning it at your own cost would eat into any recovery. Escalating isn't worth the delay unless the crack makes the lamp unstable or unsafe.
